purpose: Identify whether saved sessions can decide IFix descriptor aliasing or generic context selection; preparation and profile declarations never establish execution.

GetAsType.reloadAfter: optional contextPrepare and GetObject; use the reloaded context entry, not an entry-only snapshot
GetAsType.boundary: Conditional selected native request program; opaque context bits are not a runtime closed-type identity.

GenericDelegate.FuncReloadAfter: Execute and GetObject; forward the selected effective entry to contextType
GenericDelegate.ActionBoundary: These Action programs only test/prepare the context carrier; they have no local typed result-entry query.
GenericDelegate.representationBoundary: Native hidden context and managed System.Reflection.MethodInfo closure references are different representations.

requiredObservations: Same-session call/thread identity and exact selected code location for each snapshot.
Actual source and destination Value addresses, complete pre-copy source bytes, evaluation base, field index and selected unmanaged-field address.
Reloaded receiver/unmanaged-array/header/field-address stability across copy and rebase, separately from managed-array references.
Source tag read after both copy stores; on the managed branch, destination Value1 write and Stfld source Value1 read after rebase.
Managed array identities, lengths and selected reference before the assignment/store requests; post-request state and normal completion are separate observations.
representativeBranches: partial overlap changing the post-copy tag guard
Stfld rebase changing the subsequently read source index
descriptorAliasing.entryOnlyBoundary: An entry reference identifies neither the selected Value byte ranges nor the post-copy guard, rebase, managed read or completed store.
descriptorAliasing.acceptance: A complete loss-free session with authenticated native sites and correlated observations may establish only the sampled address/byte/array relation. Compare against the native equations only when their stable-storage premises are independently supported.
descriptorAliasing.stop: Missing phases, changed address/header premises, failed reads, losses or absent completion keep the affected consequence unresolved. Pointer reuse across calls is not object lifetime.

requiredObservations: Selected ordinary or adjustor entry and raw incoming argument/hidden-context carriers, with exact per-entry native ABI proof.
Saved incoming context, preparation selection and the effective selected context entry used by the actual query after its preceding helper calls.

Typed query argument and returned Type/reference or unbox address/result bits, with correlated return observations; reference GetObject pre-clear reference and post-clear physical slot are separate phases.

For a closed-type claim, independently authenticated runtime generic declaration/instantiation records and raw Type carriers; ordinary code address, MethodSpec index or a printed name alone is insufficient.
For an adjustor claim, paired receiver/context observations before and after the receiver adjustment and at the ordinary target; an on-disk adjustor cell alone does not select invocation.
representativeBranches: same code address with distinct runtime contexts
genericContexts.entryOnlyBoundary: A registered shared generic entry does not identify the supplied runtime MethodInfo, closed type, effective query context, cast/unbox success or returned storage.
genericContexts.acceptance: Admit raw point observations only inside an authenticated complete session. Closed-type and result claims additionally require their own declaration/Type and paired-return proofs; retain unknown contexts without guessing a stored candidate.
genericContexts.stop: Missing incoming/effective contexts, byref ambiguity, unsupported runtime layouts, unmatched pairing, failed reads or losses withhold the corresponding claim.

requiredObservations: Selected fix record and registered wrapper identity
Same invocation IsPatched/GetPatch selection and Execute entry
patchExecution.acceptance: IFix local observations do not establish that a declared patch replacement ran unless this separate path is observed.
patchExecution.stop: Keep file declarations, native body candidates and observed execution identities separate.

profileBoundary: This auditor recognizes retained native entry-profile declarations. It does not implement a new paired observer protocol, decode an IFix session or upgrade profile fields to runtime claims.
sessionBoundary: Rebind saved inspection, collection inventory, profile and provider summary before reporting capabilities. Reuse upstream inspection admission explicitly; a changed or incomplete receipt withholds even that reuse.
instrumentationBoundary: Offline only. No game launch, attachment, capture, injector or shared observer edits.
